title: Official NEET (UG) 2026 Syllabus
subtitle: National Medical Commission (NMC) & National Testing Agency (NTA) Curriculum

subjects.name: Physics
subjects.description: 20 Units covering Mechanics, Electrodynamics, Thermodynamics, Optics, Modern Physics & Experimental Skills.

units.name: Physics and Measurement
units.topics: Units of measurements, System of Units, SI Units, fundamental and derived units, least count, significant figures, Errors in measurements, Dimensions of Physics quantities, dimensional analysis, and its applications.

units.name: Kinematics
units.topics: Frame of reference, motion in a straight line, Position-time graph, speed and velocity, Uniform and non-uniform motion, average and instantaneous velocity, uniformly accelerated motion, velocity-time, position-time graph, Scalars and Vectors, Vector addition/subtraction, scalar and vector products, Unit Vector, Resolution of Vector, Relative Velocity, Motion in a plane, Projectile Motion, Uniform Circular Motion.

units.name: Laws of Motion
units.topics: Force and inertia, Newton's First, Second and Third laws of motion, Momentum, Impulses, Law of conservation of linear momentum, Equilibrium of concurrent forces, Static and Kinetic friction, laws of friction, rolling friction, Dynamics of uniform circular motion: centripetal force and applications (level and banked road).

units.name: Work, Energy, and Power
units.topics: Work done by constant force and variable force; kinetic and potential energies, work-energy theorem, power. Potential energy of spring, conservation of mechanical energy, conservative and non-conservative forces; motion in a vertical circle, Elastic and inelastic collisions in 1D and 2D.

units.name: Rotational Motion
units.topics: Centre of mass of two-particle system and rigid body; moment of a force, torque, angular momentum, conservation of angular momentum; Moment of inertia, radius of gyration, parallel and perpendicular axes theorems, Equilibrium of rigid bodies, equations of rotational motion, comparison of linear and rotational motions.

units.name: Gravitation
units.topics: Universal law of gravitation, Acceleration due to gravity (variation with altitude and depth), Kepler's laws of planetary motion, Gravitational potential energy, gravitational potential, Escape velocity, Motion of a satellite, orbital velocity, time period and energy of satellite.

units.name: Properties of Solids and Liquids
units.topics: Elastic behaviour, Stress-strain relationship, Hooke's Law, Young's, bulk, and shear modulus, Pressure due to fluid column, Pascal's law, Viscosity, Stokes' law, terminal velocity, streamline/turbulent flow, critical velocity, Bernoulli's principle, Surface energy, surface tension, angle of contact, capillary rise, Heat, temperature, thermal expansion, specific heat capacity, calorimetry, latent heat, Heat transfer: conduction, convection, radiation.

units.name: Thermodynamics
units.topics: Thermal equilibrium, zeroth law of thermodynamics, concept of temperature, Heat, work, internal energy, First law of thermodynamics, isothermal and adiabatic processes, Second law of thermodynamics: reversible and irreversible processes.

units.name: Kinetic Theory of Gases
units.topics: Equation of state of perfect gas, work done on compressing a gas, Kinetic theory of gases: assumptions, concept of pressure, RMS speed of gas molecules, Degrees of freedom, Law of equipartition of energy, specific heat capacities, Mean free path, Avogadro's number.

units.name: Oscillations and Waves
units.topics: Periodic motion, time period, frequency, displacement, Simple harmonic motion (SHM) and equation, phase, oscillations of a spring, Simple pendulum, Wave motion: longitudinal and transverse waves, speed of wave, Principle of superposition, reflection of waves, Standing waves in strings and organ pipes, harmonics, Beats.

units.name: Electrostatics
units.topics: Electric charges, Conservation of charge, Coulomb's law, superposition principle, Electric field, field lines, Electric dipole, torque on dipole, Electric flux, Gauss's law and applications (wire, sheet, spherical shell), Electric potential, potential difference, equipotential surfaces, Conductors and insulators, Dielectrics, capacitors and capacitances, series and parallel combination, energy stored in capacitor.

units.name: Current Electricity
units.topics: Electric current, Drift velocity, mobility, Ohm's law, Electrical resistance, V-I characteristics, Series and parallel combinations of resistors, Temperature dependence of resistance, Internal resistance, EMF and terminal potential difference, Kirchhoff's laws and applications, Wheatstone bridge, Metre Bridge.

units.name: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
units.topics: Biot-Savart law and circular loop application, Ampere's law (straight wire and solenoid), Force on moving charge in magnetic and electric fields, Force between parallel conductors, Torque on current loop, Moving coil galvanometer, conversion to ammeter and voltmeter, Magnetic dipole moment, Bar magnet, magnetic field lines, Para-, dia- and ferromagnetic substances, effect of temperature on magnetic properties.

units.name: Electromagnetic Induction and Alternating Currents
units.topics: Electromagnetic induction: Faraday's law, Lenz's law, Eddy currents, Self and mutual inductance, Alternating currents, peak and RMS value, reactance and impedance, LCR series circuit, resonance, power in AC circuits, wattless current, AC generator and transformer.

units.name: Electromagnetic Waves
units.topics: Displacement current, Characteristics and transverse nature of electromagnetic waves, Electromagnetic spectrum (radio, microwaves, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays), Applications of EM waves.

units.name: Optics
units.topics: Reflection of light, spherical mirrors, mirror formula, Refraction at plane and spherical surfaces, thin lens formula, lens maker formula, Total internal reflection and applications, Magnification, Power of a lens, combination of thin lenses, Refraction through prism, Microscope and Astronomical Telescope, Wave optics: wavefront, Huygens' principle, Interference, Young's double-slit experiment, Diffraction due to single slit, Polarization, Brewster's law.

units.name: Dual Nature of Matter and Radiation
units.topics: Dual nature of radiation, Photoelectric effect, Hertz and Lenard's observations, Einstein's photoelectric equation, Matter waves, de Broglie relation.

units.name: Atoms and Nuclei
units.topics: Alpha-particle scattering experiment, Rutherford's model, Bohr model, energy levels, hydrogen spectrum, Composition and size of nucleus, atomic masses, Mass-energy relation, mass defect, binding energy per nucleon, nuclear fission and fusion.

units.name: Electronic Devices
units.topics: Semiconductors, semiconductor diode, I-V characteristics in forward and reverse bias, diode as rectifier, LED, photodiode, solar cell, Zener diode as voltage regulator, Logic gates (OR, AND, NOT, NAND and NOR).

units.name: Experimental Skills (18 Practical Activities)
units.topics: 1. Vernier calipers 2. Screw gauge 3. Simple Pendulum 4. Metre Scale moments 5. Young's modulus 6. Surface tension by capillary rise 7. Co-efficient of Viscosity 8. Speed of sound in resonance tube 9. Specific heat capacity by mixtures 10. Resistivity using metre bridge 11. Resistance by Ohm's law 12. Galvanometer figure of merit 13. Focal length (Convex/Concave mirror & lens) 14. Triangular prism angle of deviation 15. Refractive index using travelling microscope 16. p-n junction diode curves 17. Zener diode breakdown voltage 18. Identification of Diode, LED, Resistor, Capacitor.

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.description: 20 Units comprising Physical Chemistry (Units 1-8), Inorganic Chemistry (Units 9-12), Organic Chemistry (Units 13-19) and Practical Chemistry (Unit 20).

units.name: Some Basic Concepts in Chemistry
units.topics: Matter and its nature, Dalton's atomic theory, Laws of chemical combination, Atomic and molecular masses, mole concept, molar mass, percentage composition, empirical and molecular formulae, Chemical equations and stoichiometry.

units.name: Atomic Structure
units.topics: Electromagnetic radiation, photoelectric effect, Hydrogen spectrum, Bohr model (postulates, energy, radii, limitations), de Broglie relation, Heisenberg uncertainty principle, Quantum mechanical model, orbitals, quantum numbers, Aufbau principle, Pauli exclusion, Hund's rule, electronic configuration.

units.name: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
units.topics: Ionic and covalent bonds, Lattice enthalpy, Electronegativity, Fajan's rule, dipole moment, VSEPR theory and shapes of molecules, Valence bond theory, hybridization (s, p, d orbitals), Resonance, Molecular Orbital Theory (LCAOs, sigma/pi bonds, bond order), Hydrogen bonding.

units.name: Chemical Thermodynamics
units.topics: System and surroundings, First law of thermodynamics (work, heat, internal energy, enthalpy), Heat capacity, Hess's law, Enthalpies of reaction, Second law of thermodynamics, Spontaneity, Entropy (delta S), Gibbs energy (delta G and delta G standard), Equilibrium constant.

units.name: Solutions
units.topics: Concentration terms (molality, molarity, mole fraction, %), Vapour pressure of solutions, Raoult's Law (ideal and non-ideal solutions), Colligative properties (lowering of vapour pressure, depression of freezing point, elevation of boiling point, osmotic pressure), Abnormal molar mass, van 't Hoff factor.

units.name: Equilibrium
units.topics: Dynamic equilibrium, Physical and chemical equilibria, Law of chemical equilibrium, Kp and Kc, Le Chatelier's principle, Ionic equilibrium: acids and bases (Arrhenius, Bronsted-Lowry, Lewis), pH scale, common ion effect, salt hydrolysis, solubility product, buffer solutions.

units.name: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry
units.topics: Oxidation and reduction, oxidation numbers, balancing redox reactions, Electrolytic and metallic conduction, Kohlrausch's law, Electrochemical cells, electrode potentials, Nernst equation, Gibbs energy relation, Dry cell, lead accumulator, Fuel cells.

units.name: Chemical Kinetics
units.topics: Rate of reaction, factors affecting rate, order and molecularity, rate law, rate constant, zero and first-order reactions (characteristics and half-lives), Arrhenius theory, activation energy, collision theory.

units.name: Classification of Elements & Periodicity
units.topics: Modern periodic law and periodic table, s, p, d, f block elements, periodic trends in atomic/ionic radii, ionization enthalpy, electron gain enthalpy, valence, oxidation states, chemical reactivity.

units.name: P-Block Elements (Group 13 to 18)
units.topics: General Introduction: Electronic configuration and general trends in physical and chemical properties across periods and down groups; unique behaviour of first element in each group.

units.name: d- and f-Block Elements
units.topics: Transition Elements: electronic configuration, occurrence, physical properties, ionization enthalpy, oxidation states, atomic radii, color, catalytic behavior, magnetic properties, complex formation, K2Cr2O7 and KMnO4 preparation and properties. Inner Transition Elements: Lanthanoids (contraction) and Actinoids.

units.name: Co-ordination Compounds
units.topics: Werner's theory, ligands, coordination number, denticity, chelation, IUPAC nomenclature, isomerism, Valence bond approach, Crystal field theory (color and magnetic properties), Importance in qualitative analysis and biology.

units.name: Purification & Characterisation of Organic Compounds
units.topics: Purification: Crystallization, sublimation, distillation, differential extraction, chromatography. Qualitative analysis: Detection of N, S, P, and halogens. Quantitative analysis: Estimation of C, H, N, halogens, S, P, Empirical and molecular formulae calculations.

units.name: Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry
units.topics: Tetravalency of carbon, hybridization, IUPAC nomenclature, Homologous series, Isomerism (structural and stereoisomerism), Covalent bond fission (free radicals, carbocations, carbanions), Inductive effect, electromeric, resonance, hyperconjugation, Substitution, addition, elimination, rearrangement reactions.

units.name: Hydrocarbons
units.topics: Alkanes (conformations, halogenation mechanism), Alkenes (geometrical isomerism, electrophilic addition, Markovnikov rule, ozonolysis), Alkynes (acidity, addition reactions), Aromatic hydrocarbons (benzene structure, electrophilic substitution, Friedel-Crafts alkylation/acylation, directive influence).

units.name: Organic Compounds Containing Halogens
units.topics: General methods of preparation, properties, reactions, Nature of C-X bond, Mechanisms of substitution reactions (SN1, SN2), Environmental effects of chloroform, iodoform, freons, and DDT.

units.name: Organic Compounds Containing Oxygen
units.topics: Alcohols, Phenols, and Ethers (preparation, dehydration, Reimer-Tiemann, Kolbe), Aldehydes and Ketones (nucleophilic addition, Grignard, aldol condensation, Cannizzaro, haloform test), Carboxylic Acids (acidic strength and factors).

units.name: Organic Compounds Containing Nitrogen
units.topics: Amines (classification, nomenclature, basic character, identification of primary/secondary/tertiary amines), Diazonium Salts (synthetic importance in organic chemistry).

units.name: Biomolecules
units.topics: Carbohydrates (aldoses, ketoses, monosaccharides, disaccharides, polysaccharides), Proteins (amino acids, peptide bond, primary/secondary/tertiary structures, denaturation, enzymes), Vitamins, Nucleic Acids (DNA & RNA structure and biological function), Hormones.

units.name: Principles Related to Practical Chemistry
units.topics: Detection of extra elements (N, S, Halogens) and functional groups (hydroxyl, carbonyl, carboxyl, amino), Inorganic preparations (Mohr's salt, potash alum), Organic preparations (acetanilide, p-nitro acetanilide, aniline yellow, iodoform), Titrimetric exercises (oxalic acid vs KMnO4, Mohr's salt vs KMnO4), Qualitative salt analysis (Cations: Pb2+, Cu2+, Al3+, Fe3+, Zn2+, Ni2+, Ca2+, Ba2+, Mg2+, NH4+; Anions: CO3 2-, S 2-, SO4 2-, NO3-, NO2-, Cl-, Br-, I-), Enthalpy experiments, Lyophilic/lyophobic sols, Chemical kinetics.

subjects.name: Biology
subjects.description: 10 Units covering Botany and Zoology: Diversity, Plant & Animal Anatomy, Cell Biology, Plant & Human Physiology, Reproduction, Genetics, Biotechnology & Ecology.

units.name: Diversity in Living World
units.topics: What is living?, Biodiversity, Taxonomy & Systematics, Binomial nomenclature, Five kingdom classification (Monera, Protista, Fungi, Lichens, Viruses, Viroids), Plant Kingdom (Algae, Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, Gymnosperms), Animal Kingdom (non-chordate up to phyla, chordate up to class).

units.name: Structural Organisation in Animals & Plants
units.topics: Morphology and anatomy of flowering plants: Root, stem, leaf, inflorescence, flower, fruit, seed; Plant families (Malvaceae, Cruciferae, Leguminosae, Compositae, Gramineae); Animal tissues, Morphology and anatomy of systems of an insect (Frog).

units.name: Cell Structure and Function
units.topics: Cell theory, prokaryotic and eukaryotic cell structure, Plant and animal cell, Cell organelles (Endomembrane system, mitochondria, ribosomes, plastids, nucleus, chromosomes), Biomolecules (proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, nucleic acids, enzymes), Cell division (Cell cycle, Mitosis, Meiosis and significance).

units.name: Plant Physiology
units.topics: Photosynthesis (light reactions, cyclic/non-cyclic photophosphorylation, Calvin C3 and Hatch-Slack C4 pathways, photorespiration), Cellular Respiration (glycolysis, fermentation, TCA cycle, electron transport system, respiratory quotient), Plant growth and development (seed germination, differentiation, hormones: auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, ethylene, ABA).

units.name: Human Physiology
units.topics: Breathing and Respiration (mechanism, gas transport, disorders), Body fluids and circulation (blood groups, cardiac cycle, ECG, disorders), Excretory products and elimination (nephron, urine formation, kidney regulation, dialysis), Locomotion and Movement (sliding filament theory, skeletal system, joints, disorders), Neural control (nerve impulse generation/conduction, CNS/PNS), Chemical coordination (endocrine glands, hormones, disorders).

units.name: Reproduction
units.topics: Sexual reproduction in flowering plants (gametophyte development, pollination, double fertilization, seed and fruit formation, apomixis, polyembryony), Human Reproduction (male and female systems, gametogenesis, menstrual cycle, fertilization, pregnancy, parturition, lactation), Reproductive health (contraception, STD prevention, IVF, ZIFT, GIFT).

units.name: Genetics and Evolution
units.topics: Mendelian inheritance, Deviations (incomplete dominance, co-dominance, multiple alleles, pleiotropy), Chromosome theory, Sex determination, Linkage and crossing over, Mendelian & chromosomal disorders (Down, Turner, Klinefelter syndromes), Molecular basis of inheritance (DNA/RNA, replication, transcription, genetic code, translation, Lac Operon, Human Genome Project, DNA fingerprinting), Evolution (origin of life, Darwinism, natural selection, Hardy-Weinberg principle, human evolution).

units.name: Biology and Human Welfare
units.topics: Health and Disease (pathogens causing Malaria, Typhoid, Pneumonia, Amoebiasis, Dengue, Chikungunya), Immunology, vaccines, Cancer, HIV/AIDS, Drug and alcohol abuse, Tobacco abuse, Microbes in human welfare (household, industrial, sewage treatment, biofertilizers, biocontrol).

units.name: Biotechnology and Its Applications
units.topics: Principles and processes of Biotechnology: Genetic engineering, Recombinant DNA technology, Applications in health and agriculture: Human insulin, gene therapy, Bt crops, Transgenic animals, Biosafety, Biopiracy and patents.

units.name: Ecology and Environment
units.topics: Organisms and environment: population interactions (mutualism, competition, predation, parasitism), population attributes, Ecosystem: productivity, decomposition, energy flow, ecological pyramids, Biodiversity and its conservation: patterns, importance, loss of biodiversity, hotspots, endangered species, Red Data Book, biosphere reserves, National parks and sanctuaries.
